brief:
The U.S. Embassy in Jerusalem released a video of Ambassador Jack Hickman's visit to Ramallah, showing him seated at a Palestinian family's table surrounded by men and women. A plate of maklouba, a traditional Palestinian dish, was placed before him during the gathering.

The video's release drew attention to the ambassador's engagement with Palestinians in the occupied West Bank city, Shehab Wire reported. The nature and context of the diplomatic visit were not detailed in the available account.
dek: The U.S. Embassy in Jerusalem released a video of Ambassador Jack Hickman's visit to Ramallah, showing him seated at a Palestinian family's table surrounded by men and women.
title: U.S. ambassador visits Palestinian home in Ramallah
